title: TARGet: Topology-Aware Fusion-based Radio Frequency Circuit Functional Modeling using Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.22165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic synthesis of analog and Radio Frequency (RF) circuits is an emerging area that requires an efficient circuit modeling method. In recent years, Machine Learning (ML) solutions have played a promising role in this regard. However, many existing ML approaches require separate training data for each circuit topology, even when a single circuit component is added or removed. In addition, they overlook circuit topology information, which limits their ability to capture complex component interactions. Furthermore, they rely on fully connected neural networks with flat feature representations, which require substantial amounts of training data. In this work, we propose an open-source topology-aware RF circuit modeling method, TARGet. Our model considers the circuit at two levels: sub-circuits and the overall circuit topology. translated_title: TARGet：基于图神经网络的拓扑感知融合式射频电路功能建模
translated_abstract: 模拟电路和射频（RF）电路的自动合成是一个新兴领域，需要高效的电路建模方法。近年来，机器学习（ML）解决方案在这方面展现出良好的前景。然而，许多现有的机器学习方法需要针对每种电路拓扑单独准备训练数据，即使只是添加或删除一个电路元件也是如此。此外，这些方法忽略了电路拓扑信息，限制了其捕捉复杂元件交互的能力。而且，它们依赖于采用平坦特征表示的全连接神经网络，需要大量的训练数据。在本工作中，我们提出了一种开源的拓扑感知射频电路建模方法TARGet。我们的模型从两个层次考虑电路：子电路层面和整体电路拓扑层面。在子电路层面，TARGet利用S参数表示来捕捉子电路行为，而不是……
tldr: 提出了一种开源的拓扑感知图神经网络方法TARGet，通过在子电路层面利用S参数表示并在整体拓扑层面进行融合建模，克服了传统机器学习方法需针对每种电路拓扑单独训练、忽略拓扑信息且依赖大量数据的缺陷，实现了高效的射频电路功能建模。
en_tdlr: TARGet is an open-source, topology-aware graph neural network method that fuses sub-circuit S-parameter representations with overall circuit topology, enabling efficient RF circuit functional modeling while overcoming the topology-specific training data requirements and flat feature limitations of prior machine learning approaches.
